answers.install_rollback_narrative: Installed foundry.retrieval@1.1.0, resolved ['mech.fuse', 'mech.rank', 'mech.retrieve']; rolled back to 1.0.0, re-resolved ['mech.rank', 'mech.retrieve']. Delta before-minus-after=['mech.fuse']; after-minus-before=[]. Every lineage ref on the rolled-back pack resolved; dropping the lineage record or planting sources_unresolved fired by name.
answers.version_bump_requires: Bumping is computed from a pack diff, not from the version string. Removal, lineage_ref rewrite, privilege/source_policy widen, or channel change requires major; adding a workflow or preset requires minor; metadata-only is patch. Publishing 1.1.0 content as 1.0.1 is refused (required=minor, code=insufficient-bump).
answers.what_pack_contains: A workflow pack is the unit of distribution: pack_id, SemVer version, channel (stable|beta|nightly), one or more workflows each carrying certification_ref, lineage_ref, tool_permissions and source_policy, plus bundled presets that must not widen those privileges. Publish emits a marketplace record with artifact_digest and the resolved lineage_set (union of sources_declared).
